Name: New Emily and Haley Portraits by Bucket
Author: MrsTNT69
Description:
I was never a big fan of frontal portraits, so I gave Emily and Haley a slight pose change — the same angled look many other NPCs have!
These portraits shift their angle toward a soft profile while keeping their original charm. And yes —[b] breasts exist in the real world[/b], so I added them :3

Maybe in the future I can add more variants or outfits for them. For now, [i][b]Enjoy[/b][/i]!!
